semantic_alignment_candidate_boundary: P07_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_ALIGNMENT_VIRTUAL_R1 is separate and not used as Live-qualified authority in this data experiment
purpose: Determine whether the reinforced DB64/9-Contract candidate is structurally trustworthy, authority-safe, consumer-routable, and ready for an isolated engine adoption pilot without replacing DB59 prematurely.
research_questions: Are the individual work, cumulative DB64, and Learning Bundle physically intact and exactly paired where they claim shared bytes/authority?
Are the 9 Contracts implemented as separated Canonical(C1-C5), Consumer(A1-A2), and Governance(G1-G2) layers rather than decorative fields?
Do known implementation risk areas C3, C5, A1, G1, and G2 satisfy the frozen machine requirements strongly enough for engine consumption?
Can selected evidence mutation change the routed packet/provider-facing semantic payload while an unrelated unselected mutation remains invariant?
Does any candidate metadata falsely promote A2 or CONSUMER_READY_A without engine causal evidence?

nine_contract_machine_requirements.C1: decision/transformation meaning must support a writer decision, not only summarize content
nine_contract_machine_requirements.C2: scope/granularity must be identifiable at the appropriate series/episode/sequence/scene/character/relationship/group layer
nine_contract_machine_requirements.C3: state representation must preserve more than an undifferentiated before->after when trigger/carry/next-constraint is materially needed
nine_contract_machine_requirements.C4: DIRECT_SOURCE_AUTHORED vs DERIVED_EVIDENCE vs RUNTIME_PROJECTION must remain distinguishable
nine_contract_machine_requirements.C5: epistemic status must be distinguishable from owner/cast grounding; SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/NO_EVIDENCE semantics must not be faked
nine_contract_machine_requirements.A2: may not PASS from field existence; requires selected mutation adoption plus irrelevant-unselected invariance through consumer/provider-facing payload trace
nine_contract_machine_requirements.G1: db_authority_id,schema_version,canonical_or_derived,source_cutoff,episode_cutoff/version binding must be available at execution boundary
nine_contract_machine_requirements.G2: failure_type,observed_layer,responsible_ancestor,repair_scope,protected_scope,repair_action,post_repair_result must be representable in repair evidence

causal_adoption_pilot.control: unaltered frozen SIKGAEK candidate consumer packet
causal_adoption_pilot.selected_mutation: one actually selected evidence value is altered without changing identifiers or routing question; packet/provider-facing semantic payload must change
causal_adoption_pilot.unselected_mutation: one unrelated unselected evidence value is altered; selected packet/provider-facing semantic payload must remain byte-identical

decision_policy.QUALIFIED_FOR_ENGINE_PILOT: all hard integrity/pairing gates pass; C1-C5/A1/G1/G2 are sufficiently machine-consumable; A2 mutation/invariance harness passes; no false promotion claim
decision_policy.HOLD_FOR_DATA_REPAIR: candidate bytes are intact but a contract implementation gap blocks reliable routing/adoption/governance
decision_policy.A2_PENDING: integrity and static contract quality pass but the causal adoption harness cannot be validly executed from available candidate artifacts
